purpose: keep dependencies current and safe through small, tested updates on a regular schedule
entry_criteria: Lockfiles exist and the test suite is reliable enough to detect breakage
A schedule and an owner for updates exist
Advisory feed or audit tool is available
procedure: List outdated and vulnerable dependencies, with security fixes first.
Group low-risk updates; update high-risk or major-version dependencies one at a time.
Read the changelog for breaking changes and deprecations before updating.
Run the full test suite and any relevant scans after each update.
Merge through the normal review (stage 72 for new dependencies), with rollback by reverting the commit.
Record versions changed and any deferred updates with a reason and a date.
acceptance_criteria: Security updates are applied within the agreed time
Deferred updates have a reason and a date
validation_method: Review of the update pull request.

validation.command: pip list --outdated   # example; use the ecosystem's tool

validation.expect: tests pass and no unresolved high or critical advisory

failure_modes.detection: Many failures after a batch update
failure_modes.response: Split and update one at a time
Read changelogs; add a test for the changed behavior

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A monthly run updates six minor versions in one pull request after the tests pass, and moves one major-version upgrade into its own tracked change with a migration test.
